_comment: Single source of truth for which Awake preview PNG diffs against which real shadcn/ui reference PNG. Consumed by tools/compare_parity.py's --all mode and by ShadcnReferenceComparisonTest.kt (samples/ui-showcase/src/desktopTest) -- keep both in sync with this file rather than hardcoding the pairing twice. 'awake' is a preview id from ShadcnParityScreenshotTest.kt (rendered to samples/ui-showcase/build/ui-previews/<id>.png); 'reference' is a filename in docs/reference/shadcn-previews/.

pairs.name: tooltip-local-light
pairs._comment: Reference captures [data-slot=tooltip-content] only (the open bubble) -- pairs against the bubble-only preview, not the trigger button. See awake-tooltip-content-light's own doc comment.

_localComment: Pairs whose reference lives in docs/reference/shadcn-previews-local/ come from the local reference app (tools/capture_shadcn_local.py) and carry a 'local': true flag. Those are authoritative: components render from the pinned shadcn checkout. Entries without the flag still point at the legacy scrape of ui.shadcn.com and are being migrated.
